objects.description: During the [2026 Iranian Water Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0065), [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) manipulated critical shutdown and alarm logic, which would allow the system to enter unsafe process states without proper notification or protections.(Citation: CISA-AA26-097A)
